{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine merino turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, soft blue-gray (#8fa3b8), extra-fine merino wool

Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal (#3a3f47), lined wool flannel

Thermal leggings worn under the trousers, close fit, ankle length, black (#1c1c1e), merino wool blend

Textured blazer-style cardigan, straight cut, hip length, deep navy (#1f2c47), thick bouclé wool knit

Long parka coat, slightly belted, knee-to-mid-calf length, with a hood, dark navy (#17223b), water-repellent down-fill with a windproof shell

Ankle boots, block heel of 3 cm, rubber lug sole, round toe, black (#1a1a1a), waterproof treated leather with warm lining, easy to wipe clean of road salt

Wool socks, calf length, heather gray (#8a8d93), thick merino wool

Scarf, wide and long, wrapped twice, burgundy (#7a2338), soft lambswool

Beanie hat, fitted, ear-covering, charcoal (#3a3f47), wool with fleece lining

Gloves, wrist length, black (#1c1c1e), lined leather, touchscreen-friendly fingertips

Tote bag, structured, medium size, black (#1a1a1a), coated leather that wipes clean

Why this outfit works: The layers of thermal leggings, merino, a bouclé cardigan and a down parka keep you warm through a 20-minute walk in deep frost and snow, while the office look underneath stays neat and business-appropriate once the coat is off. The waterproof boots with a grippy sole handle snow and road salt, and the leather wipes clean when you arrive. The soft blue-gray top echoes your eye color and sits well against your fair skin and dark hair, and the burgundy scarf adds a warm accent against the cool navy and charcoal base.
